description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
A client token to ensure that the request is idempotent.

Generate a unique parameter value from your client. The ClientToken parameter can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the request as the **ClientToken**. Each API request has a unique **RequestId**.

description.zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

- **true**：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

- **false**（默认值）：发送正常请求。
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: Performs a dry run to check the request. No resources are modified.

- **false** (default): Sends a standard request.
The ID of the ECR instance.

title.zh: 删除专线网关（ECR）及关联关系

descriptions.zh:
- 强制删除专线网关实例，会将绑定的资源一次性全部删除，请确认删除后不影响业务稳定性。

- 只能删除**Active**状态的专线网关实例。
descriptions.en:
- Force deleting an Express Connect Router (ECR) instance detaches all associated resources. Before you proceed, confirm that this operation does not disrupt your services.

- You can delete only ECR instances that are in the **Active** state.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun expressconnectrouter force-delete-express-connect-router --dry-run true --ecr-id ecr-fu8rszhgv7623c0000 --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-000000 --region cn-hangzhou
